A HUGE Persistent‑World ASCII RPG With 2.5D Depth, Endless Systems, and Zero Graphical RequirementsCity of Ages  [experience a true open world - persistent world - the last Ascii retro game for game collectors]

City of Ages is a unique and immersive text-based game that offers a different gaming experience. It is designed for players who enjoy collecting games and can read along to solve hidden abilities within the text environment. The game is server-side driven, ensuring that it is impossible to cheat against other players. It supports up to 46 players simultaneously and is compatible with various other game servers. The game includes features like item randomization, stats, rare items, unique items, treasures, and a starship system. Players can also engage in various mini-games and use commands to enhance their gameplay experience. The game is perfect for those who appreciate a different type of gaming and can read along to solve hidden abilities.

• City of Ages, is a fully persistent, text‑driven RPG where imagination does the rendering and the world never resets. Drop an item, bury it, hide it on your starship—log out for a week and it will still be there. Built on a hardened server engine with over two decades of development, City of Ages delivers a massive feature set in a lightweight, instantly‑loading package.

================= Language Support Details and a Special Thanks to my beta testers of over 26+ years !

Supportive Languages: Microsoft Visual Basic 6, and twinBASIC

twinBASIC is a modern implementation of the classic Visual BASIC (VB Access) programming language, designed to provide 100% backward compatibility with existing VB6 and VBA projects. It aims to serve as a complete replacement for the VB6 IDE and compiler while introducing numerous enhancements and new features. This project is actively under development and offers a preview version for users to explore and contribute feedback. It is particularly useful for developers looking to modernize their VB6 or VBA projects without losing compatibility.

CHAT GBT likes this type of game, I even asked it which one was the best!

Text worldbuilding hits a different part of the brain—in the best way. 🧠✨

Although nothing but words and a picture, City of Ages let your imagination do half the rendering, which somehow made everything feel bigger and more personal than any map or cutscene ever could. A single well-written room description could carry mood, history, even threat. You weren’t just seeing the world—you were co-authoring it in your head.

And CoA was especially good at:

• implying vast history without lore-dumping

• letting silence, absence, and rumor do storytelling work

• making places feel old, used, and layered

Text MUDs also reward attention. If you read carefully, the world opened up. Miss a line, and you might miss a secret, a tone shift, or a quiet warning. That kind of literacy-as-skill is rare now.

END MESSAGE FROM THE AUTHOR

I wanted that game where 46 people could play one large WORLD together, no instances, no loading times, no boredom. You wonder, how did I achieve this perfect gaming database system? I miniaturized all games into one using Ascii text graphics, spending more time on the code. I wanted a game when I say something globally everyone can read  what I said. I wanted a game that anyone could use my built in SQL Server and create anything in the database at anytime an administrator needs to. Using SQL is designing fast code! I wanted a GOOD ADDICTIVE GAME just like you do! 30 years later, Presto, here it is with all source code as well ! City of Ages became everyone's favorite pet project. I challenge anyone to make a nice Unity client for City of Ages, collaboration on a project is everything to a team effort! The idea is to make this game work on all platforms one day soon. The server is fine to operate on a Windows OS.

I created a Text Universe...

PURPOSE and PREMISE of MY GAME

 The premise of my game is to collect Crowns of Glory to forge with. I wanted a game where leveling isn't that important, that gains from existing player stats [i.e.. strength intelligence wisdom dexterity constitution charisma and finally luck]  would be more important before leveling, this way you get more hit points and mana and essence and soul and movement points. You can get all stats and gains and special attributes on items! I wanted to fly above the realm too in a 3D (x y z) environment; I wanted a game with starships and true x y z to beam down anywhere in the realm. This is my favorite RPG designed game because I wanted a game with lots of mini-door games that run [independently and randomly] as you play anywhere in our lovely City of Ages RPG world. While you solve quests these mini-games will start for you to play randomly and automatically. This is my favorite game because, I can watch YouTube or play a simple graphics game and go and [alt-tab] back to play City of Ages, and then I check any mini-games that might be running. If I win a game that is another way to earn Crowns of Glory to forge with. I made a new command 'GAMES' to see all the available mini-door games running status. Cost effective laptops with any graphic chip/card has no problem running City of Ages. We all wanted that awesome game that runs on any Windows/emulator compliant computer, here is the game. The best part is, I coded AI into everything: even the clan system is now automated, immortals no longer are required to maintain this Text RPG, it maintains itself now. Almost all other Text MUDs out there require the attention of an Immortal, to restart the MUDs, reboot their servers due to memory issues, and to help their players advance and receive clan titles. This MUD does it all on its own ! 

What if we told you, after 30 years of careful design and development, we shrunk a billion dollar company that used to exist in the 90s into this tiny package--and we do not have to have a payroll or crazy bills [46 people x a phone line = saved $$$], technology made it free to you to enjoy nearly as it was. We used to all connect to a Multiplexer that would relay a modem network. Amazing evolution, So collect and love my game its a self proclaimed Multiuser Dungeon Masterpiece. You will initially connect to your own MUD if you used the steam city of ages windows client for this game. Use tools to switch ports. You are all welcome to use the descriptor board and place your IP address there in this homepages description so that others can join your version of this game. You can even make money and keep it all after 2038, I will be retired then, its all in the EULA.City of Ages: The Ultimate Persistent World Text RPGExperience City of Ages, a highly optimized, persistent-world MUD that delivers a massive, deep role-playing experience without the need for high-end hardware. As an open-world text adventure, it combines the nostalgic charm of classic ASCII retro games with advanced, modern mechanics. Whether you are a dedicated MUD veteran or a collector of unique PC gaming experiences, City of Ages offers a stable, bug-free, and immersive environment that runs on any laptop, providing a seamless RPG experience that respects your time and hardware.

Advanced Immersive FeaturesCity of Ages bridges the gap between traditional text-based gameplay and modern MMORPG dynamics. Our engine supports up to 42 simultaneous players in a living world with no cumbersome instances or loading screens. Explore a true X/Y/Z coordinate system that adds depth to exploration, combat, and starship travel, proving that text-driven RPGs remain among the most engaging experiences in gaming.

• Persistent World: Items remain where you place them, even after server reboots—bury your loot, decorate your house, or store gear on your starship.

• Deep RPG Systems: Engage in complex crafting, spell-casting, transmutation, and evolving pet systems. Choose from diverse character classes and races, then watch your character grow through the powerful progression engine.

• Intelligent AI Integration: Enjoy a world that functions autonomously with automated clan systems, dynamic NPC raids, and quest engines that keep the adventure fresh without requiring constant administrator oversight.

• Accessibility & Compatibility: Featuring screen-reader support, simplified text modes, and bitmap graphics compatibility, this game remains inclusive for all types of players.

Mini-Games, Combat, and ExplorationBeyond our immersive role-playing core, City of Ages packs an impressive array of side activities. When you need a break from traditional questing, dive into our integrated mini-door games that offer unique challenges and the chance to gather Crowns of Glory for forging. Engage in high-stakes space exploration, PvP flag captures, or test your luck in the casino.

Technical Excellence for Retro Game CollectorsBuilt for stability and efficiency, our SQL-driven server code ensures instant response times and a secure, cheat-free environment. This is a self-sustaining RPG designed to endure, with full support for modern Windows environments via twinBASIC compatibility. We invite you to join our long-running community, host your own server, and discover why we are considered a true "Titan of Text."

Key Reasons to Play City of Ages• Zero Graphical Hardware Required: Runs flawlessly on any laptop or 32-bit Windows system.

• True Persistent World: An authentic open-world experience where your impact on the environment lasts.

• Massive Feature Set: From starship combat and 3D navigation to complex weather systems and mimic encounters.

• Community Driven: Join a legacy project over two decades in the making, now welcoming a new generation of players.

City of Ages is more than just a game; it is an invitation to co-author a grand adventure. Embrace the power of your imagination and join a world where the story is only as limited as your next command. Connect today, set your coordinates, and begin your journey into the most comprehensive text-based MMORPG ever released.
